source:
@@U01132@@
And here!

@@U01133@@
(He lifts one of the bed curtains.)

@@U01134@@
What a shiver of joy comes over me! I could linger here for hours. It was here, blesséd Nature, that in gentle dreams you formed her into the angel she was born to be. Here lay the child, the warmth of life filling her tender body, and here, by God’s pure and holy weaving, the image of divinity took form. But you! What brings you here? How deeply my soul is stirred! What do you want? Why is your heart so heavy? Poor 浮士德, I no longer know you. Am I the prisoner of some magic fragrance? I came here driven by lust for immediate pleasure, and now feel myself dissolved in a dream of love. Are we the prey of every breath of air? If she were to enter at this instant, how you would suffer for your offense! The swollen braggart, so petty now, would lie here, melting, at her feet.

@@U01136@@
(Entering. )

@@U01137@@
Quick! I see her coming down below!

@@U01139@@
Away! Away! I'll never come again!
translation:
@@U01132@@
还有这里！

@@U01133@@
（他掀起其中一张床帘。）

@@U01134@@
我感到多么高兴啊！我可以在这里逗留几个小时。正是在这里，神圣的大自然，您在温柔的梦中将她塑造成她与生俱来的天使。孩子躺在这里，生命的温暖充满了她娇嫩的身体，在这里，通过上帝纯净而神圣的编织，神性的形象成形了。但你！是什么风把你吹到这里来的？我的灵魂受到多么深刻的震撼！你想要什么？你的心为何如此沉重？可怜的浮士德，我已经不认识你了。我是某种神奇香气的囚徒吗？我来到这里是出于对即时快乐的渴望，现在感觉自己沉浸在爱的梦想中。我们是每一次呼吸的空气的猎物吗？如果她这个时候进来，你该多受罪啊！那个浮肿的吹牛者，现在变得如此渺小，将躺在这里，在她的脚下融化。

@@U01136@@
（进入。）

@@U01137@@
快点！我看到她从下面下来了！

@@U01139@@
走开！离开！我再也不会来了！
